# stream-processor-lite

> Event-time stream windows (tumbling, sliding, session) with watermarks, late-data side output and exactly-once file output across restarts Python package `trysac-stream-processor-lite`, import name `stream_processor_lite`, MIT licensed,
> Python >= 3.10, no runtime dependencies.
